def r(x):
    # Identity transform is used as a last resort.
    # The Lorenz system has (x, y, z) -> (-x, -y, z) symmetry, but the initial condition
    # z_0 = 30x + 5 is strictly monotonic on [0, 1], meaning no two distinct inputs x
    # can yield the same z_0, preventing a non-trivial exact invariant transform.
    return x


def R(y_orig, y_new):
    # Under the identity transform, the final state trajectory is identical,
    # so the L2 norm of the final state must be equal.
    return abs(y_orig - y_new) <= 1e-6
